name: Off-Road Vehicle
description: Any vehicle manufactured for off-road use that doesn't meet the federal motor vehicle safety standards for road use when built, such as an off-road electric dirt bike or an ATV. Titled by the Office of Motor Vehicles and identified with an off-road decal.

restrictions.rule: Manufactured for off-road use and not meeting Louisiana's motor vehicle safety requirements when built; no limit on wheels, power or speed
Titled by the Office of Motor Vehicles and issued an off-road decal, renewed every four years; farm use is exempt from the decal
Not designated for road use: kept off public roads except in the narrow cases the statute allows, none of which apply in Orleans Parish

May use the shoulders of public roads other than interstates, in daylight, only for farm-related activities within five miles of a farm, by an operator with a Class E driver's license; incidental crossings are allowed
University and college employees, police and certified paramedics may ride one for work on the streets of a state college or university campus
Operators must show proof of liability insurance on demand when riding under those exceptions
The motorcycle helmet law doesn't apply when riding under those exceptions
